chapters: Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ gu' cham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu ux gu jodai' tu duukam; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Abisag gu Sunamita aichdhak gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt ka't gu takarui' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n; gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit jix búup bham; gio ba' tu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu taat cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bɨx gu tanoolh bɨɨx a'ga; gio ba' gu ñi'ook a'ga gio gu ux ka't jix duñia' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan u'ua'tɨdham gu Adoniia.
Gu' gu' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Reii gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii cham oi'ñchu' gu Adoniia.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Adoniia kakneer gu jodai' gu vaakax gu chuukug ju'ñdharan jodai kavɨk gu Soelet mia'n suudai' buusñi gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bɨx xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'.
Gu' gu' cham jix duñia' gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' gu Benaiia tu' gu Salomoon xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan gu Bat-seba gu naan gu Salomoon bham; gio ba' cham naak gu ñi'ook gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit cham maachim gu Dabii chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jano' jix bhɨɨ gu kutun na ba' nukadham gu oidha' gu mar gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' tu' ba'k gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu takarui'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' atooxkor gu ñi'ook gu Adoniia.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' tu' ba'k bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Bat-seba chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Abisag gu Sunamita gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bat-seba jix duñia' tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ux gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' atooxkor.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' gu Adoniia gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' jano' cham gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu chuukug mumua'da' kakneer tu' amuub bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joab gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gu' gu Salomoon tu duukam cham tu' amuub.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel bhaan tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook chɨkka tu' gu jodai' atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx tattat tu' gu mar gu Salomoon duduaka' gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' kua' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr na ja'p chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' o'lhia'n vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Adoniia gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' atooxkor.

Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu chuukug mumua'da' kakneer tu' amuub bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gio gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu suudai' jugi i'i vupui bhaan jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Adoniia.
Gu' gu' tu' tu duukam tu' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' tu' gu Salomoon tu duukam tu' amuub.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ux gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' cham jix daa jix duñia' tu duukam chɨkka ka't gu jodai' atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Bat-seba; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug.
Na na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu mar gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' atooxkor pai' gu chuukug; na gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Bat-seba jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tai gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr baap gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu takarui' tu duukam gu Jawatan xoi'kam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salomoon gu mar gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Gioon.

Jano' ba' tu jiim gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk bham; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu suudai' ɨlhdham jix duñia' atooxkor gu ñi'ook gu ux tu'; na gu' jix duñia' na ba' ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Ameen; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' ka't bɨɨx gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix gɨ' atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' gu Kereteos gu Peleteos jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salomoon gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhɨɨk gu Gioon.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tu jiim gu Salomoon; gio ba' jix duñia' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk jix aa' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu chuukug gu kutun gu chuukug gu oidha' gu tanoolh bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Adoniia bɨx koi'cham bɨɨx mi'p na pai' dhuuk tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' tɨiñ gu Joab gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam kiicham bɨɨx gu jodai'.

Ba' jix aa' kua' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' gu suudai' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan suudai' u'va gu Adoniia; na gu' ba'k na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu suudai' gu jodai' jix bhai' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' gio gu Kereteos gu Peleteos jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' maa'n gu Gioon gu ux gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu suudai' kiicham gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' naak.
Jano' ba' gio gu Salomoon tu' daakat atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' tɨbiap jix bhai' aa' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Salomoon gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oi'ñga'n jix gɨ' atooxkor gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook atooxkor gu chuukug gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix búup bɨx koi'cham mi'p bɨɨx gu Adoniia ka't maa'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' gu Adoniia gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Salomoon jix búup ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maachim gu Salomoon bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Adoniia juraa'n ɨɨbhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; na gu' tu' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon; gio ba' tu' ka't jix bhai'x tu' maa'n kuupa'n gu chuukug gu oidha'; gu' tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' koi.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon aichdhak jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' suudai' u'va jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon jix aa'; jano' ba' gu chuukug gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu Dabii na ba' koi jix aa'ñdhix gu Salomoon gu mar bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu takarui' tu' gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix nukadham jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jiim gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr tu' gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' na ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam nukadham gu bhóogɨt jiim vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ mɨɨjidha' tu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' gu chio'ñ atooxkor gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' ñɨidhat tu' gu ñi'ook gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar gook gu jodai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu Amasa gu mar gu Jeter mu'aa gu suudai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr bhɨɨ'ñdham jix dhaas gu ɨ'ɨr bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook ga'ra' bhaan gu ñi'ook ga'ra' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu jurtu'nka' matda'; gio ba' cham kiicha' jix dhaav gu jodai' o'o bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Barsillai gu duukam jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch ka't koi'cham gu vaak na jix bhai'; na pai' dhuuk na gu' tɨɨtɨs tu' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu Absalom xibhɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gio gu ñi'ook bɨndak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Gera gu mar gu Benjamiin gu Baurim gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mu'ai jix kavɨk gu tanoolh tu' gu chuukug gu Maanaim; gu' jix dhaav gu jodai' gu Jordaan tu' gu takarui' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu' kooda' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jano' cham gu jodai'; na gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu chuukug ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix duu jix dhaav gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix koox bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm gu takarui'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Salomoon atooxkor gu Dabii gu taat ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit suudai' u'va gu Bat-seba gu naan gu Salomoon; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr namkia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix aa'; jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu chuukug bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu vupui na ba' tu' gu jodai'; gu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't bhaan suudai' u'va xibhɨk; na gu' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu vupui; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na gu' tu' soi'ñ tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na gu' cham tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ba' jix maa gu Abisag gu Sunamita gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Bat-seba; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Bat-seba gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' ñiokda' gu ux gu Adoniia; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix búup tu jiim jix duñia' atooxkor jix duu jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu naan gu gɨ'kora' jix daa kɨɨ'n.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu vupui; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu naan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Abisag gu Sunamita gu ux gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu Adoniia.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu naan; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Abisag gu Sunamita na ba' gu Adoniia gu oi'ñga'n gio na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na gu' xibhɨk jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr juraa'n gio gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Adoniia dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii gu taat tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu Adoniia koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bhañ gu ux gu novɨ gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' jix maa bhaan jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Anatot dɨppɨr tu' gu chuukug suuska'n koi'm; na gu' gu' cham tu' kooda' gu ñi'ook na gu' baabuk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Dabii gu taat gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu Salomoon gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak gu Eli gu Silo.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu Joab; na gu' gio gu Joab ka't jix bhai'x gu Adoniia tu' xoi'kam cham ka't jix bhai'x gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Joab vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook maachim gu Salomoon gu Joab ka't jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Salomoon gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bham; mi' dhɨr gu Be jix maa bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Benaiia vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook koi; gio ba' gu Benaiia jix duñia' bɨɨx dhi' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' bham; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Joab jix aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu vupui na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug tu' gu vaak gu taat gu ɨ'ɨr gu Joab tu' vaak na jix bhaan gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan mo'o; na tu' jix koi gook gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jir bhai' ja'tkam tutkɨ mu'aa gu ñi'ook cham gu taat gu Dabii gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu Amasa gu mar gu Jeter gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu ɨ'ɨr gu chuukug bhaan mo'o gu Joab bhaan mo'o gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gu' bhaan gu Dabii bhaan gu kai' bhaan gu vaak bhaan atooxkor gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x bhai'x i'ii'ñ baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix tɨ'ɨ jix maa bhaan jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas pai' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Sadok jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu ux jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu Abiatar.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr bhañ gu gɨ'kora' jix duu gu kutun gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jerusalem jix koi gu oi'ñga'n cham gu bhóogɨt baasɨ'n tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu maa'nkar tɨɨda' gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jix duñia' koi gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu duukam; jano' ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem mui'x gu tanoolh.

Gu' gu' gu oi'ñga'n vaik gu takarui' ka't jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook gook tu duukam gu Akîs gu mar gu Maakâ gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat; gio ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu duukam gu Gat.
Jano' ba' jix búup jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Gat gu Akîs gu suudai' tu duukam; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu duukam gu Gat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon na ja'p gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ jix duu gu kutun gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tu' gu takarui' tu' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' bham; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu takarui' gu maa'nkar tɨɨda' koi tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat bɨx cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ xoi'kam gu maa'nkar jugi bhaan gu taat gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt cham bhai' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon ka't gu takarui' atooxkor gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'ñdhix gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' jix buus naaka'n; gio ba' jix koi; mi' dhɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't tu jiim gu novɨ gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon gu chuukug bɨɨx gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na gu' jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon jix bhɨɨ kiicham gu Dabii tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem xikoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' cham ka't gu vaak gu jodai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' gu Salomoon jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jiim ñi'ook kavɨk gu taat gu Dabii; gio ba' gu suudai' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.

Na gu' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu kutun na gu' gu bhóogɨt ka't jix bhai'x gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix bhai'x maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Salomoon bhaan mii' dhɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon gu kutun gu tukaa' tɨɨtki' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix maa.

Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat bhaan jix jiim vupui bhaan tu' tu'r bɨx bhai' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu' nukadham dhi' jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch chɨɨdak gu mar gu suudai' atooxkor na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook tu' tu duukam gu ux gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu takarui' jix ali' cham tu' gu ñi'ook baakɨi tu' jix buus.
Jano' ba' tu duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' cham jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix maa tu duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' cham bhai'; na gu' chɨkka gu kutun gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu chuukug gu Salomoon gu suudai' dhi'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook dhi' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tu' mui'x gu tanoolh tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tu' namkɨm tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' jix maa gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu jodai' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt va'k tu' na ja'p tu' mi' dhɨr tu' jix búup na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gio tu' jix maa tu'x cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't na ja'p tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' jiim gu bhóogɨt nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook jix ñi' ka't gu vaak; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem jix duñia' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duu gio gu takarui' bɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu jodai' tɨɨtɨs gook gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu' dhi' gu u'vɨ jix koi gu vaak tu' gu suudai' kua' bɨɨx gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't vaik gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' gu chuukug jix duñia' gio jix koi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mai' ka't gu vaak gu ñi'ook gook gu vaak.
Na gu' gu tukaa' gu mar dhi' gu u'vɨ jix koi na gu' jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix búup ɨraab gu tukaa' jix bhɨɨ gu mar ju'ñdharan tu' kua' tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios kookos jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu mar jix koi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu xibh na ba' gu chuukug baaso gu mar gu suudai' ka't jix koi; gu' gu takarui' gu ux gu xibh tu' cham ka't gu mar tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu mar jix duñia' gu mar jix koi; jano' ba' jix duñia' a'ga; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu mar jix koi gu mar jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba'; gio ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu mar jix duñia' gu mar jix koi; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham gu' gu oi'ñga'n jix koi gu mar jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix maa tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu mar gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na gu' ba'k jix duñia' gu tasi' gu mar; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug jix maa gu chuukug gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui'; gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu mar gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu naan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix kai mii' dhɨr ñi'ook na jir bhai' ka't jix maa gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na gu' jix duñia' ka't matda' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu chiñia' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Asariias gu mar gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Eliorep gu Aiia gu ma'nkam gu Sisa gu o'o; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Ailud gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' ka't bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Asariia gu mar gu Nataan ka't bhaan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu Sabud gu mar gu Nataan ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Aisar ka't gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; gio ba' gu Adoniram gu mar gu Abda ka't bhaan namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Salomoon gu kutun gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak; gio ba' maa'n ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ux gu takarui' oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu mar gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu vaak gu Makkas gu Saalbim gu Bet-semes gu Eloon gu Bet-anan.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu kutun gu Arubot; gio ba' gu ux ga'ra' gio gu Sokô bɨx gu oidha' gu Epet.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux ga'ra' gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Tapat mar u'vɨ gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Baana gu mar gu Ailud gu Taanak gu Megiddo bɨx gu Bet-san mia'n gu Saretaan gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel dɨr gu Bet-san bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel-meola bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu Jokmeam.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu tasi' gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ux ga'ra' gio jɨ'dɨlh gu Jair gu mar gu Manasees mi'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr ga'ra' gio oidha' gɨ' gu Argob ka't gu Basaan gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kup jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Ainadab gu mar gu Iddo gu Maanaim.
Jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ux jix bhɨɨ gio gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Basemat mar u'vɨ gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Baana gu mar gu usai gu Aser gu Alot.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu maa'nkar gu Issakâr.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Ela gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Geber gu mar gu Uri gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan; gio ba' gu ux ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' mii' dhɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Israeel jix duñia' mui'x na ja'p oo' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu oi'ñga'n oo' i'i gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Salomoon aapi' bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' i'i gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Salomoon gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh jix pai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Salomoon ka't gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu vaakax gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n chiiw gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'uvhig gu chuukug.

Na gu' na gu' aapi' bɨx jix suudai' duu ka't baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim dɨr gu Tipsa bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ux bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Israeel gu takarui' gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨtaa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨtaa'n iigɨx dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu suudai' dhi' gu Salomoon oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix duñia' kavaayo na ba' gu ñi'ook gu kutun mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu bhóogɨt meesa gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon aajidha' maa'n gu takarui'; gio ba' gu chuukug cham tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gio i'i kai' vaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook pai' ka't maa'n jurtu'nka' gu chuukug ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon matda' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu kutun gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na ka't jix gɨ' matda' gu Salomoon gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' bɨx matda' gu Egipkios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix maat gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Etaan gu Esraita gu Emaan gu Kalkôl gu Darda gu ma'nkam gu Maol; mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' ua'rgidhat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx gɨ' jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' gu u'u dɨr gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu vaakax gu u'uvhig gu ko'oi gu vatop.
Jano' ba' aajidha' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt matda' gu Salomoon gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' pai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n matda'.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gio tu duukam gu Salomoon jix kai gu suudai' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu taat; na gu' gu iram ka't bɨɨx tas dha' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon bhañ gu chuukug gu iram.

Jano' ba' tu' ñɨidhat na ja'p gu taat gu Dabii cham gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu takarui' gu suudai' gu vaas tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ux bɨx gu bhóogɨt; na tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n tu' cham bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' tu' gu ux gu jodai' gu tanoolh jano' gu chuukug gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' gu mar tu' gu bhóogɨt pai' gu oi'ñga'n atooxkor jix duñia' gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix jano' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu duukam no'm bɨɨx gu jodai' tu' gu suudai' gu ux tu duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chuukug; na gu' tu' ñɨidhat xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu oi'ñga'n tu juan gu u'u na ja'p gu Sidonios.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu iram jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon jix duñia'; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu mar jix maat gu Dabii bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu iram gu chuukug gu Salomoon; gio ba' naak jix aa'ñdhix gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨx tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu u'u ka't.

Jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan jix duñia' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu ux gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm pai' tu' buimɨk jix duñia' tu' jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu aagak gu chuukug jugi ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu iram gu Salomoon gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu u'u ka't bɨx gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu Salomoon jix duñia' gu iram gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chuukug tiriik na ba' gu duukam ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bɨ'ñdhatu' na jix bhai'; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu Salomoon gu iram oidha' tas.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon matda' na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu iram gu Salomoon jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu takarui' namki'ñdha' bɨx gu Israeel namki'ñdha' ka't gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu takarui' gu ux gu ja'tkam bai'ñpu' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gook masaa'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu Adoniram ka't bhaan mii' dhɨr namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gio gu Salomoon gu vaak mambhɨɨx gɨ' jix duñia' gu takarui' jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Salomoon mi'p bhaan tu duukam vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai u'uuk na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu jodai tu juan.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ ka't jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux vaik kɨɨv gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux; na gu' gu ux mai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt na ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu tasi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik.
Jano' ba' tu juan gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vaak bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu vaak gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu vaak bɨɨx gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jiim ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu suudai' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook jiim tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨndak gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham mi'x dhaas gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu Salomoon tu juan gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu chuukug gu u'u gu ux gu ñi'ook dɨr gu jodai' gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu u'u ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gɨ' u'u kavɨk dɨr gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu takarui' pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu vaak maachim vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu ñi'ook ga'ra' oo'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu vaak ka't iiñat gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ux gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu jodai' gu chuukug; gio ba' bɨx ka't gɨ' u'u kavɨk; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu jodai gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ux gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak na ba' gu takarui' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka't baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' jix bhaan dhaas jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Salomoon jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ba'k gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam jix uam jodai jix duñia' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai bɨx gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' jix uam jodai bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't vupui bhaan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu takarui' gook gu suudai' gu u'u gu suudai' maa'n gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ga'ra' jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na ba' ka't mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ga'ra' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas dhi' ja'tkam gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n maa'n gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix uam jodai gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai gu suudai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook mai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu ba'k gu takarui' kiki'ñgob gu u'u gu suudai'; gio ba' gu kutun gu maa'nkar jix duñia' jixchamaam gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gook kiki'ñgob jix duñia' gu u'u gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu jodai' gu chuukug jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan dhaas gio jix uam jodai gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' ki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu maa'nkar gu u'u gu suudai' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x vaik gu bhóogɨt gu jodai tu juan gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' maakobh oi'ñga' gu takarui' gu Sip mi'x juu'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n oi'ñga' gu takarui' gu Bul gu takarui' jix bhai'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak bɨɨx bɨx gu takarui' bɨɨx bɨx bɨɨpɨ'm; gio ba' pai'x kɨɨv gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan maakobh gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gɨ' u'u kavɨk bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gɨ' u'u kavɨk bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't iiñat gu bhóogɨt gɨ' u'u kavɨk jiix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' oo'm jixchamaam gu vaak; gio ba' gu ux ga'ra' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ga'ra' jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ka't vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duu gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ atooxkor ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix duñia' gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't gu jodai u'uuk gu jodai mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai gu tasi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jiix jix duñia' gio gu jodai u'uuk tu juan jurtu'nka' gu suudai' tu duukam gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ xikoolh ka't vaik gu bhóogɨt gu jodai tu juan gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gɨ' u'u kavɨk; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu kutun gu Tiro gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gook gu vaak jix vɨgɨ jodai gu ñi'ook ka't mambhɨɨx gu tasi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gook gu jodai' gu jodai jix vɨgɨ jodai na ba' bhaai'n gu oi'ñga'n bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ka't jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu suudai' jix vɨgɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug na ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu takarui' bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu jodai'; gio ba' kɨɨv na ba' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' mi'p bhaan gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ux maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ko'kmarak gio gu jodai' bhaan gook gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gook gu bhóogɨt xikoolh gu jodai' tu jiim vook gu jodai' vook ka't vupui bhaan gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu takarui' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' xikoolh gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu gɨ' suudai' gu ux bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mambhɨɨx novɨ maa'nkar gu chuukug gu gɨ' suudai' xikoolh gook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' gu jodai' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' ka't gu novɨ gu ñi'ook ka't tu juan na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu takarui'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix vɨgɨ jodai gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt ga'ra' maakobh gu ñi'ook jix vɨgɨ jodai bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix vɨgɨ jodai; gio ba' maakobh gu takarui' ka't gu takarui' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨtaa'n gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' maakobh gu ñi'ook mi'p bɨtaa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't novɨ maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' bɨx ka't gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' maakobh gu takarui' maakobh gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ novɨ maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu jiim gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu ux gu ñi'ook xikoolh gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu vaak mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix vɨgɨ jodai; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook oo'm gu i'ii'ñ ka't maakobh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bhaan mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ tu jiim gu vaak jixchamaam gu novɨ o'nsop; gio ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak tas buusñi bhaan saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ' suudai' gu kutun gu vaakax bɨtaa'n gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu ux gu maa'nkar jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu Jordaan gu oidha' u'u gat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sukkot gu Sartaan.

Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh dhi' jix maa xibhɨk jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oidha' gu Kabul bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu iram gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n namki'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu takarui' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu asor gu Megiddo gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto ka't jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhɨɨ gu Geser gu bhóogɨt ka't jix koi gu Kananeos oi'ñka' kiicham gu suudai' gu duukam mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Salomoon gu Geser gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-oron.
Jano' ba' gu Baalat gu Tadmor gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh pai' gu Salomoon ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨx gu Salomoon jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Amorreos gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseos cham jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook bɨɨx namki'ñdha' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui' gu Salomoon gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu suudai' chiñia' gu ñi'ook jugi gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bhaan buimɨi jix duñia' gu takarui' mambhɨɨx mi'p bhaan gu ja'tkam jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon kiicham gu Dabii gu vaak gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' pai'x gu ux.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon vaik mui'kim oi'ñga' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bhaan ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu takarui' gu Esioon-geber ju'ñdharan gu Elat gu vaak gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu iram tu duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Opir jix bhɨɨ jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook cha'tmam aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu suudai' gu Seba gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Salomoon gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' jugi bɨɨx jix ai gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai jix gɨ' gu tasi' gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' na ja'p suudai' u'va gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu Seba jix ñi' bɨx matda' gu Salomoon gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jugi gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' maa'nkar tai bhaan maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu'r tu' gu oidha' tu'x matda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' tu' cham gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm tɨbiap gu vupui jix duñia' buupui tu' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't; gio ba' jix gɨ' matda' xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' ka't naak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam jix bhai'x vupui bhaan tu' gu suudai' matda'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu takarui' jix duñia' tu' na ba' gu takarui' atooxkor gu Israeel; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dha' bɨɨx tas gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu suudai' gu Seba jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu iram ka't gu jodai' jix uam jodai gu Opir gu ñi'ook gio gu Opir gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u gu takarui' gu jodai a'bhar.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu u'u gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu kutun na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gio gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu takarui' tu' buupui bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa gu suudai' gu Seba bɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨx jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Salomoon jix maa na ja'p gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; gio ba' jix duñia' ka't gu oidha' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ga'ra' gu duukam oi'ñga' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Arabia gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu oi'ñga'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix uam jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' vaik gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n jix duñia' vaik gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ga'ra' atooxkor jix bhai'x ka't gu ja'tkam gu ux gu jodai'; gio ba' baasɨ'n ga'ra' gu oi'ñga'n mia'n gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan mi'p gu takarui' gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' mi'p gio gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook atooxkor nɨidhim.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ux i'i gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix duñia' jix uam jodai gu suudai' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook ka't jix uam jodai gu chuukug; gio ba' cham ka't jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon cham ka't jix duñia'.

Na gu' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' ga'ra' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ busaak gu gɨ' suudai' gu Tarsis bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu iram; gio ba' jix duñia' vaik gu takarui' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Tarsis gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu jodai' gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' namkɨm matda'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Salomoon na ba' gu bhóogɨt matda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix duñia' oi'ñga' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ux jix uam jodai gu ux jix toja jodai jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt kavaayo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' ga'ra' jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu kutun jix bhai'x gu jodai' jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem jix toja jodai na ja'p gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk na ja'p chiiw gu ux vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kavaayo bhiibgich gu Salomoon gu Ejipto; na gu' chu'p jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' jugi kavaayo bhiibgich.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' busaak gu Ejipto gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai kavaayo gu ux chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu novɨ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon mumua'da' gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu Moab gu Ammoon gu chuukug gu Sidoon gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jɨjɨkgɨm tu' jɨjɨkgɨm gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu takarui' gu chuukug bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu suudai' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon bɨɨx xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Salomoon ka't jix bhai'x gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu taat gu Dabii.
Na gu' na gu' gu Salomoon chɨ'ɨɨk gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidonios gu Milkom gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ammonitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't jix bhai'x bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Salomoon jix bhai'x gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Molok gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' bɨx gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' bhaam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Salomoon na gu' ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook gook mui'kim.
Jano' ba' ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook dhi' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gu' cham nukadham jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt dhi' tu' cham nukadham ñi'ook na jix bhaan ñi'ook kavɨk tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu oi'ñga'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' kapbhai' tu duukam.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ gu mar.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bopxi'ñ gu mar gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jerusalem tu' gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon gu Adad gu suudai' gu ɨ'ɨr vaak ja'tkam ka't gu Edom.
Na pai' dhuuk na gu' na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii ka't gu Edom jix tɨ'ɨ gu Joab gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook koko'kam jix duñia' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Edom.
Na gu' na gu' gu ux masaa'n jix daa gu Joab bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu Edom; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Adad bɨɨx dhɨt gu chichio'ñ gu chuukug tu duukam gu taat ka't gu Ejipto; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Adad gu ñi'ook jix ali'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Madiaan tɨɨtɨs gu Paraan; gio ba' dhaagɨk baidhak gu chichio'ñ gu Paraan tɨɨtɨs gu Ejipto gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix maa gu vaak nɨi'ñchudat gu jodai' gu suudai' jix maa gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Adad jix gɨ' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu Faraoon jix maa gu ux gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam tɨɨmo' gu ja'tkam gu tasi' gu Tapnes.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Tapnes jix duñia' gu mar gu Genubat jix duñia' gu Tapnes gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Faraoon; gio ba' ka't gu Genubat gu vaak gu Faraoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' tɨiñ gu Adad gu Ejipto gu Dabii ka't jix koox bɨɨx tattat ka't jix koi gu Joab gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Adad gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu takarui' tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' uañi'ñ gu chuukug gu suudai' gu chuukug gu oidha' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx jix duñia' mi'x dhaas tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Resoon gu mar gu Eliada ka't jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Adad-eser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' chu'p na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Soba; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Damasko jix daa jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Damasko.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bɨx gu tanoolh gu Salomoon; na gu' ka't cham bhai' bɨɨx gu Adad na gu' jix duñia' gu Israeel jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' gu Eprateo gu Sereda tu duukam gu Salomoon gu naan jup tɨɨt gu Serba gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ux jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't dhi'; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' kiicham gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jeroboam ka't jix kavɨk gu takarui'; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Salomoon biapma' ka't gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bɨx gu chuukug gu vaak gu Josee.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gamai' gu Jeroboam gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Aiias gu Silonita; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx gu vaak gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr mi'p gook gu duukam yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Aiias gu vaak gu ja'tkam ga'ra' bhaan jix duñia' gu kutun bapaalh.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' mambhɨɨx bapaalh; na gu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu Salomoon tu' gu suudai' mambhɨɨx bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jerusalem kiicham tu' gu tasi' bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba'.

Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim jix duñia' gu jodai' gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidonios gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moab gu Molok gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' na ja'p jix duu gu Dabii gu taat.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu jodai' cham tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam tu' gu takarui' nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk.
Gu' gu' tu' gu jodai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu mar gu suudai' tu' mambhɨɨx bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu suudai' bopxi'ñ na ba' tu duukam gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh vupui bhaan tu' gu Jerusalem kiicham tu' gu takarui' na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ tu' gu takarui' bɨx tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ ka' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ naak bɨx tu'x tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Dabii tu duukam tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' gu suudai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu suudai' gu Dabii tu' kapbhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu kai' gu Dabii kuiñcha dhi' gu' cham na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu Salomoon kooda' gu Jeroboam gu' kɨkbo gu Jeroboam jix duñia' gu Ejipto gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto juruuñ gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm koi'm gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon bɨx tu'x matda' cham ua'ñix u'uan gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Salomoon jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Salomoon bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu taat gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Roboam gu mar.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Roboam gu bhóogɨt; na gu' bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨbiap gu bhóogɨt na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' ka't na ja'p jix kai gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' ka't gu Ejipto na gu' ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix daa gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ tɨɨt; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨx gu takarui' gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Roboam bham.
Jano' ba' gu taat jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' gu tasi' gu' jano' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu jodai' juantu'n gu taat gu tasi' gu ñi'ook jix dhaas bhaan no'ch tu' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' vaik gu tanoolh gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx daraa gu suudai' dhi' vupui bhaan gu Salomoon gu taat na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug tu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu' tu juan na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Gu' gu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu kutun kɨklhi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix maa jix bhɨɨ gu kutun bɨɨx biipibop gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨɨx mi'p vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu taat jix dhaas bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' biipibop a'ga jix duñia' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu taat jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' gu tasi'; gu' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix ali' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' jano' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'; gio ba' gu taat naaka'n bɨɨx gu chuukug gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Roboam; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix aa'ñdhix bham; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu kutun daraa gu suudai' jix maa.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' gu kutun biipibop bham; gio ba' gu taat jix duñia' gu tasi' gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr gu taat naaka'n bɨɨx gu chuukug gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' cham jix kai gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Aiias gu Silonita gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't naak jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n tañia' no'ch bɨɨx gu Dabii cham tañia' gu maa'nkar gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel dhi' gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu vaak gu Dabii jano' ba' gu Israeel ka't dhi'.
Gu' gu' jix gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix koi jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhañ gu Adoram ka't bhaan bopxi'ñ; gu' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel jix koi; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel gu vaak gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't tɨiñ bɨx gu Israeel gu Jeroboam ka't gu bhóogɨt mɨjɨ tɨɨt gu ñi'ook jix duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel cham gu bhóogɨt bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Roboam suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem jum daa'ñ bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin chamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu vaak gu Israeel gu suudai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gu jodai' gu ja'tkam bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook maa'n gu vaak; na gu' dhi' gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suulh jix bɨɨx duu jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu Jeroboam gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Epraim jix daa; gio ba' gamai' jix duñia' gu Penuel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' tu' dhi' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan gu Roboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa yaa' tu' jix duñia' gu Roboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel tu' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas maa'n gu Bet-el jix dhaas gu Dan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't bua' uañi'ñ; na gu' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan maa'n bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jeroboam jix duñia' gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu Bet-el gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu vaak gio gu Bet-el jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duu gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Judaa gu Bet-el; gio ba' kua' gu Jeroboam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' tu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu vaak gu Dabii gu jodai' gu mar tɨɨgim gu Josiiyas gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan tu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook o'oo gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix maa nɨi'ñchudat bham; gio ba' dhi' nɨi'ñchudat gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' maatai bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix kai gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't duuñ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Bet-el jix duñia' gu novɨ dɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu jodai' gu' gu novɨ ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' ja'aa maatai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jurtu'nka' nɨi'ñchudat gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' kai'ch:―Dho gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' gu novɨ ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' na ja'p va'k.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix ai gu chuukug gu vaak jugi tu' gu suudai' gu o'o.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak cham gu chuukug bɨndak tu' jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai' dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ux gu bhóogɨt cham jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' ka't tɨbiap gu Bet-el.

Jano' ba' jix koi gu jodai' gu Bet-el jix bhai'x jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan suudai' u'va gu mar gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Bet-el; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio gu taat gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ.

Jano' ba' jiimchu' bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't daakat bɨtaa'n gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug tu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu Judaa jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu kutun gu chuukug gu vaak jiim gu takarui'.
Gu' gu' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨndak tu' tu jiim bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' jugi gu takarui' tu' i'ya' gu suudai' bɨndak dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gio jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ja'p tu' nobii'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨndak gu vaak na ba' jugi gu takarui' gu jodai' gu suudai'; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx jix jugi gu takarui' gu vaak jix i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' gu vaak na jix bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap gu Judaa bham; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu suudai'.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jugi gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' pai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't tu ñi'ook cham jugi gu takarui' tu' gu jodai' gu suudai' cham jix duñia' gu chuukug tukga'n tattat.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't jugi gu takarui' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook tu jiim jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' maavɨt gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't baas gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ka't ju'ñdharan maavɨt gio ka't ju'ñdharan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug ka't baas gu bhóogɨt maavɨt ka't ju'ñdharan gu chuukug; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gui'p kiicham pai' jix bhai'x jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix daa.

Ba' jix aa' gu takarui' ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' maavɨt tu' jix bhai'x jix koi jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook maavɨt mi'p ju'ñdharan gu chuukug; gio ba' maavɨt cham ka't jugi gu chuukug tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix bhai'x suudai' u'va kiicham na ba' gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu chuukug tukga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok gu chuukug gu ma'nkam bham; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt tukga'n jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' o'oo ju'ñdharan gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' cham jix duñia' ɨlhdham jiiñak gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Bet-el bhaan bɨx gu vaak jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jɨ'dɨlh gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' cham jix duñia' gu Jeroboam cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't kuiñcha uañi'ñ gu vaak gu Jeroboam; gio ba' gu ux ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Abiiyas gu mar gu Jeroboam jix duñia' ka'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam gu u'vɨ; na gu' bamii' jano' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham tu' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam tu' gu Silo; na gu Aiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' ka't gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu'; na tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' dhi' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix búup ka't gu Silo suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Aiias; mi' dhɨr cham gu tanoolh tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Aiias gu vupui gu suudai' jix bhai'x kuiñcha gu tasi'.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Aiias; gio ba' gu suudai' gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam ɨlhdham gu chuukug gu ux gu mar ka'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n ɨlhdham gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Aiias jix kai gu suudai' tɨɨt na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ux ki'ñgob; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' gu oi'ñga'n gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Dabii tu' kapbhai' tu'; gio ba' tu' cham jix duñia' na ja'p gu Dabii tu duukam nukadham gu ñi'ook jix jiim gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' va'k gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' bhaan bɨx jix duñia' va'k tu'; na gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bhai' bhaan gu vaak gu Jeroboam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jeroboam bɨx gu jodai' gu maa'nkar nukadham na ja'p jix bhai'x gu Israeel; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jeroboam na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu kutun bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu jodai' gu Jeroboam kiicham jugi gagai'; gio ba' gu jodai' yooxi' jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' bamii' gu chuukug gu vaak; na baakɨk tɨɨt kiicham koi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia'; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jeroboam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' tu' gaagam gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu vaak gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix búup gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jeroboam dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; na gu' jix duñia' gu Israeel dhi' jix bhai' gu oidha' ka't jix maa tattat tu jiim baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu Israeel gu ux uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam uañi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam jix búup ka't suudai' u'va gu Tirsa; gio ba' baakɨk gu ux gu kutun gu vaak gu takarui' jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ tu duukam gu Aiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Jeroboam gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; gio ba' dhaibu jix koox bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Nadab gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon jix gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na pai' dhuuk oo'm gu takarui' ka't gu Roboam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem kiicham gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Judaa cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx tattat gu suudai' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jugi.
Na gu' na gu' gio gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu jodai' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't gio gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't baas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu Nadab gu mar gu Jeroboam kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel gook oi'ñga' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gook gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Nadab bɨx tu'x cham bɨx ua'nak u'uan gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Asa gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' vaik oi'ñga' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu Tirsa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' maakob gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Jeroboam uañi'ñ bɨɨx uañi'ñ gu Israeel.

Na gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oo' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jeroboam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook daak bɨɨx uañi'ñ.
