Jano' ba' moor tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' ka't gu Ben-adad i'i gu i'ii'ñ vaak zel gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gook gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' tɨbiap u'ua'tɨdham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' chiñia' oidha' gɨ' moor dharka'; gio ba' ka't gu Ben-adad gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix maa aa'ñdham bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Samaria.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ ko'iix; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ ko'iix.
Jano' ba' moor kiicham gu suudai' chiñia' oidha' gɨ' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' naaka'n maa'n gu jodai' bhaan; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Ben-adad gu ñi'ook kavaayo bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel naaka'n gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jimɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bhaan; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu' gu kutun bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu vupui; gio ba' jix buusñi gu gɨ'kora' maa'n gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu ñi'ook pai'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook kavaayo gu ux kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx yooxi' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix maa naak jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñga' gu Ben-adad jix duñia' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Apek gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gio gu ñi'ook dhaagɨk gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' yooxi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan na ja'p gook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' jimɨɨk jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bham; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk cham gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' kapbhai' bɨx dhi' jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ na ba' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh chooto'n gu bhóogɨt yooxi' vupui bhaan kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix maa gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' jiboi'ññor gu Apek kiicham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Ben-adad suudai' u'va gu chuukug kiicham gu tanoolh gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu duukam gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' naak gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' jano' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhidham gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' u'ua'tɨda' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n ɨɨbhidham tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' tu duukam gu Ben-adad tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tai gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu takarui' jootom jix bhɨɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chin gui'p; gio ba' xibhɨk gu Ben-adad jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Ben-adad jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu Ben-adad; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu taat jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu bhóogɨt gu Damasko na ba' tu' na ja'p gu taat jix duu gu Samaria; jano' ba' tu' jix aa' gu suudai' tu' mi'x dhaas jix duu bɨɨx dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' jix duu bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan mi'x dhaas tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam duiñchu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano'; gu' gu chio'ñ cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook maavɨt; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix ai'chdhix jix duñia' maavɨt naaka'n.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix maa koi'm jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix maa jiiñak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu duukam jix buus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu takarui' maa'n jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ bham; jano' ba' gu Guarda dhi' gu chio'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' ka't gu ux gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu duukam ka't gu takarui' baasɨ'n jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu chuukug; jano' ba' tu' gu jodai'.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' jootom jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix duñia' ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu vaak jix duñia' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' ja'tkam gu takarui' ka't gu Nabot gu Jesreel ga'ra' gu Jesreel oidha' u'va ju'ñdharan gu kutun gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Nabot bham; na gu' gu bhóogɨt oidha' u'va na ba' u'uu pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' mia'n ju'ñdharan gu vaak tu' gu suudai' gu ux oidha' u'va tutkɨ dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' tutkɨ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' namkidha' gu i'ii'ñ tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' gu Nabot jix aa' gu suudai'; gio ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu' gu maa'nkar tattat.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu suudai' gu vaak jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Nabot gu Jesreel ka't tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham tu' gu suudai' gu maa'nkar tattat; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu vupui cham jix jugi gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham jugi gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Nabot gu Jesreel gu takarui' oidha' u'va gu ux tuumiñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va gu ux; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' cham tu' gu suudai' pai' u'va.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' jano' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel bamii' jugi gu takarui' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ua'na gu jodai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhañ daraa gu ñi'ook jix koi kiicham bɨɨx gu Nabot.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' ua'na am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Proklamad gu maa'nkar gu suudai' gu Nabot gu vaak gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gook gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu suudai' bhaan gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' kiicham daraa gu ñi'ook jix koi kiicham jix duu na ja'p gu Jesabel jix aa'ñdhix jurtu'nka' ua'nak gu jodai' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu Nabot gu vaak gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jano' ba' gook gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bhaan gu Nabot vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu Nabot tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' jix duñia' mai' kiicham jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai jix koi.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr mɨjɨ a'ga gu Jesabel; gio ba' gu Nabot tu' jix duñia' gu takarui' jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Jesabel jix kai gu Nabot ka't jix duñia' gu takarui' jix koi gu suudai'; gio ba' bamii' bia'ka' oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu ux tuumiñ; na gu' gu Nabot cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu suudai' gu Nabot ka't jix koi jix búup na ba' jix dhaav oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu chuukug gu takarui' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Samaria; gio ba' gu suudai' oidha' u'va gu Nabot tu' jix duñia' na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt gio gu jodai' ñiokda' bham; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' pai' gu ñi'ook gagai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu Nabot gagai' gu ñi'ook gio gu ɨ'ɨr gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gaagam bhaamki'ñdha' gu chuukug jix aa'; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na gu' tu' jix duñia' cham bhai' bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bhai' bhaan tu' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨx gu jodai' gu maa'nkar nukadham jix bhai'x gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' na ja'p gu vaak gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia; gio ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ daak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jesabel gio tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gagai' jugi gu Jesabel gu suudai' gu Jesreel.
Na gu suudai' ka't jix koi kiicham gagai' jugi; gio ba' ka't jix koi yooxi' jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu'r gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't na ja'p gu suudai' duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jesabel gu u'vɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook duiñxim jurtu'nka' bɨx jix duu gu Amorreos u'u kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba'.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' jix kai dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix dhaas gu ux bhaan gu chuukug jix duñia' jix koox gu ux jix jiim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham.

Na gu' cham buupui na ja'p gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' cham gu jodai' cham bhai' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu mar gu jodai' cham bhai' bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' vaik gu takarui' jix duñia' cham bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't vaik oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix dhaav gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ gu kutun gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu jodai' gu vaak jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p kavaayo.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jum daa'ñ na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x dhaas gui'p; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ; na gu' gu Jawatan kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kutun jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ gu ux gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla; na gu' gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt na gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu suudai' cham bhai'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' jootom gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa mi'p gu bhóogɨt maa'n gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ɨrban ju'ñdharan ba'k ki'ñgob gu Samaria; gio ba' bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ñi'ook a'aa' jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx suulhgia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' bham; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka' gu bhóogɨt; na gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda' ka't gu ja'tkam tɨɨt gu Mikêas bham; gio ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chin jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr ka't jano' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' jix duñia' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mikêas gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'x dhaas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ ka' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mui'kim gu takarui' cham gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu'r gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu Israeel gu jodai' gu ux gu kakkavɨk na ja'p kakneer cham namki' bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham namki' gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu jodai' maa'n gu vaak bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tu' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios daakat atooxkor bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr ka't ju'ñdharan kɨɨ'n gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka gu suudai' na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n chɨtda; mi' dhɨr chɨtda.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Yo gu jodai' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix buus tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jano' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' jimɨɨk jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu bhóogɨt naaka'n gu Mikêas gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ux duukat ka't tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Miren tu' gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk tu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ux gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Mikêas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amoon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' kiicham gu Joas gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr mi'x juu'ñ gu ux kuupa' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu takarui' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu ux tu'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' ba'k gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' jajannulhi'ñ; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix duñia' chɨbiapui gu chuukug.

Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' tu' bɨɨx jix gɨ' tu' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs na ba' gu ux bɨɨx; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix maa jiiñak.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt naaka'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux jix aa' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' yooxi' dhi' gu jodai'.
Gu' gu' gu chuukug ka't gu jodai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' juruuñ gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu xumai jix koi; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu ux baaso gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tas jix buus gu jodai' gu ux yooxi' bham; gio ba' maa'n kiicham gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu jodai' gu Samaria; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu Samaria; gio ba' jix duñia' gio gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gagai' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨx tu'x jix duñia' gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx jɨ'dɨlh pai'x cham ua'nak u'uan gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu suudai' bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu suudai' gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Asa kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judaa maakobh oi'ñga' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Asuba mar u'vɨ gu Silai.
Jano' ba' jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu taat cham gu bhóogɨt duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n cham jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; na gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham ua'nak u'uan gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu Asa.
Jano' ba' cham ka't jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't pai' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux jix uam jodai; na gu' gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu suudai' gu mar gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu duukam bɨɨx gu jodai' gu takarui'; gu' gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' pai' jix gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu mar gu suudai' kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gook gu takarui' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu naan gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu tasi' jix duñia' gu Israeel; na gu' jix duñia' gu Baal jix duñia' daak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt tu'x gu taat ka't gu ñi'ook.
